claims.text: Alternative: oral 250 µg/kg, repeated in 7 to 14 days
claims.quote: Ivermectin 250 µg/kg body weight orally, repeated in 7–14 days

claims.text: Take oral ivermectin with food (better absorption).
claims.quote: Ivermectin should be taken with food because bioavailability is increased, thereby increasing penetration of the drug into the epidermis.

claims.text: No renal dose change; safety of repeated doses in severe liver disease is unknown
claims.quote: Adjustments to ivermectin dosing are not required for patients with renal impairment; however, the safety of multiple doses among patients with severe liver disease is unknown.
